# Gator Redleg Chapter of the US Field Artillery Association

> The Gator Redleg Chapter (the "Gator Redlegs") is a 501(c)(3) non-profit professional association serving Florida's Field Artillery Soldiers, veterans, and their families, in support of the 116th Field Artillery Regiment. Based in central Florida (Winter Haven area). EIN 82-4625785.

The chapter promotes the efficiency of the Field Artillery, preserves its best traditions, honors the memory of the fallen, and supports Soldiers and families through scholarships and charitable programs — "Never Leave a Fallen Comrade." It is part of the United States Field Artillery Association (USFAA).

## Key pages
- [Membership](https://www.gatorredleg.org/membership): How to join the USFAA and affiliate your membership with the Gator Redleg Chapter. Dues and membership tiers are set by the national USFAA at fieldartillery.org.
- [Support the Chapter](https://www.gatorredleg.org/support): Make a one-time or recurring tax-deductible donation, and see charities the chapter has supported.
- [Fundraising](https://www.gatorredleg.org/support/fundraising): Monetary and in-kind donation opportunities; checks payable to "Gator Redleg Association, Inc."
- [Request for Support](https://www.gatorredleg.org/support/request-for-support): Soldiers, units, and families request assistance through the chapter's charitable support programs.
- [St. Barbara's Ball](https://www.gatorredleg.org/chapter-activities/st-barbaras-ball): The chapter's premier annual event — a formal Dining Out honoring Saint Barbara, patron saint of the Field Artillery. Saturday, December 12, 2026 at the Winter Haven Armory, Winter Haven, FL, preceded by a Red Leg Social on Friday, December 11.
- [St. Barbara's Ball Sponsors](https://www.gatorredleg.org/chapter-activities/st-barbaras-ball/sponsors): 2026 sponsorship tiers — King of Battle ($2,000 presenting), Master Gunner ($500 table), Gunner ($125, sponsors a junior Soldier's attendance). PDF flyer available on site.
- [Chapter Activities](https://www.gatorredleg.org/chapter-activities): The chapter's events — Golf Tournament (spring), Kenny Fike Memorial Softball Tournament (fall), 5K Fun Run, and St. Barbara's Ball.
- [History](https://www.gatorredleg.org/history): The 116th Field Artillery Regiment, the Legend of Saint Barbara (hagiography, patronage of artillerymen, Saint Barbara's Day traditions, and the Order of Saint Barbara), the Story of Molly Pitcher, and Fiddler's Green.
- [Regimental Coin](https://www.gatorredleg.org/regimental-coin): The "End of Mission" program presenting a regimental coin to departing junior enlisted Soldiers (E-5 and below).
- [Newsletter](https://www.gatorredleg.org/newsletter): Subscribe for chapter news and event updates.
